summary: 71-year-old Texas man died at the scene of a single-vehicle accident in Colorado National Monument despite life-saving measures; NPS and Mesa County Sheriff's Department officers assisted with body recovery.
responding_agency: National Park Service; Mesa County Sheriff's Office
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: Sept-24-2013 NPS morning report says the second and third of three September fatalities occurred 'during a 24-hour period over September 18th and 19th' — the 27-year-old Virginia man's Cold Shivers Point fall was 'last Wednesday' (2013-09-18 = id 2785) and the Texas man's single-vehicle accident 'a day later' -> 2013-09-19. Report does NOT name the road (not Rim Rock Drive specifically). NPS + MCSO officers assisting with body recoveries. Precedent: id 3214 (2024-08-26 COLM rollover, NPS+MCSO+fire) is indexed.
